cohort: The cohort consisted of 51 pregnancies and births after assisted reproduction, including 43 singleton pregnancies (20 with SARS-CoV-2 infection and 23 without) and 8 multiple pregnancies.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection (primarily Omicron variant) during or up to six months prior to a pregnancy following assisted reproduction did not significantly affect the risk of maternal and fetal complications or fetoneonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in birth mode between pregnancies with and without SARS-CoV-2 infection.
